svg.title: GitHub Copilot Usage Lens logo study
svg.desc: The coffee mug logo with an animated full-name lockup, static light and dark versions, one-color versions, and small sizes. All lettering is vector outlines. The animation stops when reduced motion is requested. The GitHub Copilot icon sits before the product name, above Usage Lens.
